contract: Socket.IO outgoing user_session_closed: preserve the payload field types/optional arguments, recipient decisions, trigger conditions and observable ordering at ALL listed source call sites. Source audience hints: specific_user_clients. Verify authorized/admin/owner/restricted/revoked sockets and initial/repeat/changed/failure transitions; literal test mentions below are discovery leads only.
exceptions: Named tests are assertion leads, not complete coverage or a current execution claim. Missing source/client state and failure variants remain required.

invariants.contract: Socket.IO user_session_closed carries exactly one argument, the closed session id string. It is emitted by closeSession on a successful close (with or without listening time), an admin closing another user's session, a close after the item was deleted and a same-device replacement, exactly once per close, to every socket of the session owner only; admin sockets and other users' sockets must not receive it, and no rejected close (401, 403, 404) emits it.
